propositions.text: process(events) returns the list of idempotency keys that were applied.
Each event is a two-element list [idempotency_key, amount] where idempotency_key is a string and amount is the payment amount.
Each idempotency key is applied at most once; the first delivery of a key is applied and recorded.
A later event whose key was already applied is a duplicate and is ignored.
A duplicate is ignored even when its amount differs from the first delivery; the first delivery wins.
The returned keys are in first-seen order, the order in which keys first appeared in the input.
No key appears more than once in the returned list.
An empty input list returns an empty list.
The input list is processed in order and is not mutated.
